parties: Dotex Merchandise Private Limited (acquirer) and RPSG Ventures Limited (target)
headline: RPSG Ventures Limited: Substantial Acquisition Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Dotex Merchandise Private Limited has disclosed a substantial acquisition of shares in RPSG Ventures Limited under SEBI Regulation 31(4), triggering mandatory disclosure obligations for acquisitions crossing the 26% threshold or concert-party thresholds under the Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations, 2011.
implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosures signal completion of a creeping or open-market acquisition event; the timing and magnitude of the disclosure determine whether an open offer is triggered under Regulation 20, making the exact shareholding percentage and prior-acquisition history material to structuring and compliance.
detail: Dotex Merchandise Private Limited has submitted a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, to the NSE. This disclosure mechanism is mandatory when a person or concert party acquires shares such that their aggregate shareholding reaches, equals, or exceeds 26% of the paid-up capital, or when acquisitions occur above prescribed creeping-acquisition thresholds (5% in one financial year once prior holdings exceed 26%). The filing indicates a material change in control or significant influence over RPSG Ventures Limited.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011
framework.note: Central statute governing mandatory disclosures, thresholds (26%, creeping 5%), concert-party aggregation, and open-offer triggers.
Mandates disclosure to stock exchange within 2 trading days of acquisition of shares crossing 26% threshold or creeping thresholds; triggers Regulation 20 open-offer obligation if above 26%.
If acquisition via Reg. 31(4) crossing 26%, acquirer must make mandatory open offer to remaining shareholders at highest price paid in 52-week acquisition.
Aggregates holdings of persons acting in concert (direct/indirect common control, understanding, or coordination); key to determining if multiple acquirers breach 26% threshold collectively.

framework.ref: Companies Act, 2013 – Section 23 (foreign direct investment limits)
framework.note: If Dotex Merchandise or beneficial owner is foreign, FDI caps and approval under FDI Policy apply; upstream sectoral limits depend on RPSG's business.
Overarching statute conferring SEBI rule-making authority and stock-exchange listing standards; governs take-over code application.

framework.ref: Stock Exchange Listing Standards / NSE Rules
framework.note: NSE listing rules require timely disclosure and compliance with takeover code; listing-related undertakings and regulatory filings.
Defines natural person, company, Hindu undivided family, trust, or entity acquiring shares; determines who must file Reg. 31(4) disclosure.

conditions: Disclosure under Regulation 31(4) must be made within 2 trading days of acquisition crossing 26% or creeping thresholds
If acquisition crosses 26% threshold, mandatory open offer to remaining shareholders is triggered
Concert party analysis determines whether holdings of Dotex Merchandise and any related parties must be aggregated
approvals: NSE listing rules and corporate governance standards
Foreign Investment Promotion Board (FIPB) / DPIIT approval if Dotex Merchandise is foreign-controlled
structure.novel: Regulation 31(4) disclosure triggers automatic open-offer obligation if shareholding ≥26%; structure hinges on whether Dotex Merchandise acquired stakes via market purchases (creeping threshold) or bloc acquisition, and concert-party aggregation.

triggers.note: Mandatory disclosure when shareholding reaches/exceeds 26% or creeping-threshold acquisition occurs; filing to stock exchange mandatory within 2 trading days.
Triggered if acquisition via Reg. 31(4) crossing 26%; acquirer must make mandatory open offer at highest price paid in prior 52 weeks.

triggers.note: NSE listing standards mandate adherence to SEBI takeover code and timely disclosure to the exchange; RPSG Ventures (as listed entity) subject to these requirements.

triggers.note: If Dotex Merchandise is foreign-controlled, FDI policy approval and sectoral caps apply depending on RPSG Ventures' main business activity.
